## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION: Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; strong overall breadth but clear tech weakness and cross‑market divergences. Confirmations: (1) 9/11 sectors positive (broad participation); (2) Technology lagging with major names BELOW TREND, creating conflicting signals; Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Industrials lead: FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing strength: PEP (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.44%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.38%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND; Tech sector 4/19 positive (internal weakness). Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5) with a cyclical + healthcare tilt; Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -31.72%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high‑multiple Technology and select Consumer Discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (GOOGL, META, JPM, V, MA show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical volatility likely, watch for trend break rather than heavy conviction trades.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is in CORRECTION for several mega‑caps: GOOGL (1W: -4.48% | 1M: +0.27%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -7.68% | 1M: +1.97%) CORRECTION, while AAPL (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +6.83%) ABOVE TREND is the outlier; Tech: 4/19 positive. Net: sector breadth weak with distribution in software/higher multiple names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials showing early recovery/rotation: JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +3.03% | 1M: -6.83%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -5.23%) RECOVERY; Financials: 13/20 positive. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt confirmed by industrials + financials participation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare broadly constructive: JNJ (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare: 11/15 positive. Watch UNH (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -19.04%) BELOW TREND as a sector risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and defensive cyclical exposure (Industrials, Energy, Select Healthcare) and reduce exposure to stretched/high‑multiple Tech names that are BELOW TREND. Monitor big‑cap tech divergences and sentiment mismatches (ORCL, MSFT) before re‑adding core exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +12.90%) — breadth positive and multiple leaders ABOVE TREND; Energy (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +15.85%) — capital goods/energy names showing follow‑through. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -6.62%) — broad selling and multiple large caps BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch AAPL holding recent ABOVE TREND gains to confirm tech selective strength and guard against spillover into broader indices. Monitor MSFT staying BELOW TREND for signs of continued software re‑rating and JPM sustaining RECOVERY momentum for financial follow‑through; treat ORCL bullish headlines vs BELOW TREND price as a divergence trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
VLO (+55): VLO (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) ABOVE TREND — news confirms price accumulation. ORCL (+55): ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverging, watch for distribution or failed expectation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-60): UNH (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -19.04%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm downside risk. MSFT (-50): MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND — sentiment aligns with price weakness. BA (-45): BA (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +6.54%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines diverge from recent gains, monitor for news‑driven volatility.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given broad sector participation but pronounced Tech divergence. CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND and BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND are showing clear relative strength. Key risk: major cap tech divergences and headline/price mismatches (ORCL news vs BELOW TREND price, MSFT weakness) — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
